StoryDescription: A shepherd boy, a giant warrior, and a God who wins the battle — the story of David and Goliath from 1 Samuel 17, told panel by panel.
PanelImageCredit: Art coming soon — Lorraine's own artwork will appear here.
PanelText: David ran toward the battle line, slipped a stone into his sling, and swung it around his head. The stone flew straight and struck Goliath on the forehead. The mighty giant crashed to the ground, face first, before the eyes of both armies.
